title: The Race Around the Park: Speed and Velocity
intro: This quiz follows Emma, Noah, and Dad at the park as they learn the difference between speed and velocity—and how distance and displacement fit in.

questions.explanation: Speed tells us how fast something moves.

questions.prompt: Which formula is used to calculate speed?
questions.explanation: Speed is calculated as distance divided by time.

questions.prompt: What makes velocity different from speed?
questions.explanation: Velocity is different from speed because velocity includes direction.

questions.prompt: Emma and Noah walked one complete lap and returned to where they started. What was their displacement?
questions.explanation: Because they ended where they started, their displacement was 0 m.

questions.prompt: Two cyclists both travel at 10 km/h, but one goes north and the other goes south. What is true?
choices: They have different speeds and the same velocity
They have the same speed but different velocities
They have the same speed and the same velocity
questions.explanation: They have the same speed but different velocities because they are moving in opposite directions.
